ios.desc:
* Transcribe super fast voice notes from Apple Watch or iPhone with one tap.
* Works offline. No servers involved.
    * Transcription is 100% local to your device. Keep your notes private!
* No forced limits on recording length or number of recordings.
* Copy all or some of your entries straight from the search bar.
* Audio and text files are saved to iCloud Drive for easy access from Finder.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made a puppet of myself to demo my free Apple Watch voice notes app [video]

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I just released my first iOS app, Stardate– a way to take very quick voice notes with your Apple Watch or iPhone.

The features are kind of a mouthful: one tap to start a note, local Whisper transcription, automatic export of all data to iCloud Drive, metadata export for use with an AI...

Since it's kind of hard to explain all that in text, I knew I needed to make a demo video. But I'm a bit camera shy and didn't want to get a haircut. Fortunately I made this puppet of myself for Halloween so I thought, maybe it'd be better to have Lil Dean do the demo.

Is it working?

Check out Stardate here:

[0] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stardate-notes/id6496679661

[1] https://stardateapp.com
